problem_to_solve.description: Attempt 9 showed that user-visible ChatGPT UI state and generator-perceived context cannot be treated as the same auditable isolation domain.

advantages: The exact application-supplied request body can be constructed, serialized, hashed, and preserved before generation.
No conversation object needs to be supplied.
No previous_response_id needs to be supplied.
The package can be embedded directly as base64 input_file data inside the same request.
No Files API upload is required when file_data is used.
The tools list can be explicitly empty.
The generator need not decide whether the UI had earlier messages or attachments.
limitations: The application-level request envelope does not expose or prove absence of provider-internal system, safety, routing, or inference context.
store=false does not itself establish Zero Data Retention or zero abuse-monitoring retention.
API access, model availability, output capacity, and account configuration must be verified before protected use.

advantages: Would preserve the previous user workflow and one-shot Temporary Chat procedure.
UI-visible state could still be externally attested by the user.
limitations: Attempt 9 directly established that visible UI state and generator-perceived context cannot be assumed equivalent.
Removing generator self-audit would avoid the false equivalence test but would not make the underlying model-visible input envelope externally inspectable.
The selected environment would therefore retain an unresolved input-boundary ambiguity already observed in Attempt 9.

conditional_selection.reason: It provides the stronger externally auditable application-supplied input boundary and avoids relying on generator inference about ChatGPT UI state.
conditions_before_final_environment_deci: API credentials available without exposing them in artifacts
benign non-Hetren Responses API request succeeds
request can use an empty tools list
JSON input_file via inline file_data is accepted
foreground response can be preserved exactly
sufficient output capacity exists for the 54-case artifact
